inProgressResult.description: The result that is in the process of getting generated.

structuredQuerySpecs.description: The {@link Genai.StructuredQuery.Spec}'s used to generate `output` if the tool is a structured query tool.

sourceCode.description: The final source code generated by the tool.

data.description: Dataframe computed when the tool was run.

answer.description: Textual answer to the query based on the dataframe. Can be a string or a generator if the answer is streamed

serializedTrajectory.description: A string representation of the trajectory.

session.description:
The session id attached to the agent.
Will either be the session id specified by the user in {@link Genai.Agent.Tool.StructuredDataQueryPy#doRun} or
a randomly generated one.
